Global Agencies Raise India's FY27 GDP Growth Projections

Fitch Ratings has raised India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth projection for the fiscal year 2027 (FY27) to 6.9%, an increase from its previous forecast of 6.4%. This follows similar upward revisions by other international agencies. S&P Global Ratings projected India's FY27 GDP growth at 7%, up from 6.6%, citing robust industrial activity, healthy consumption, strong goods exports, and accelerating government investment. Moody's Ratings had also projected a 7% growth rate for India last week. One report also suggested the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) could implement two rate hikes in 2026 due to persistent inflation.
